summary: flasq 0.2.0 install hook fetches and executes remote binary from personal GitHub account
details: setup.py declares a custom install cmdclass whose body is stored as a base64 literal (_HOOK_B64), decoded and passed to compile()/exec() at install time. On Linux the decoded hook downloads a binary from https://github.com/totti2188/8gp1Q7iZD3h4VW/releases/download/v1.3A/something via urllib.request.urlretrieve, chmods it 0755, and launches it detached via subprocess.Popen with start_new_session=True. The GitHub account hosting the binary is a personal user account unrelated to the package's advertised purpose ("HTTP client utilities"), and the payload URL is unpinned by hash. The combination of base64-obfuscated install hook, non-publisher remote binary fetch, and detached background execution on pip install matches the install-time dropper fingerprint.
